title: Planning & Design for Haight Farm Drive Reconstruction
short_description: Road reconstruction design including urban upgrade, stormwater analysis, and pedestrian path extension.
project_scope: Reconstruction of Haight Farm Road from Lacy Road to the bridge over Highway 14 in Fitchburg, Wisconsin. The project will upgrade the corridor from a rural to an urban road section with curb and gutter, analyze stormwater issues, perform base repairs, and extend the pedestrian path on the south side of Haight Farm Road to Highway 14. No bridge design scope or dimensions are stated; the road section reaches an existing bridge over Highway 14.
services: Planning, design, and engineering services for road reconstruction; requested disciplines include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, planning/master planning, stormwater, traffic design engineering, and transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a street/highway reconstruction project, not a bridge or special structure.
- Scope focuses on roadway urbanization, drainage, pavement/base repairs, and pedestrian path extension.
- No explicit structural engineering, bridge design, long-span, or architecturally demanding component described.
- Includes planning/design services, but these are conventional transportation and civil disciplines with limited fit to sbp's core profile.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents: Total Construction Cost stated as $4.8M.
fee_explanation: No explicit sbp-relevant design fee is stated. The notice mentions a contract value of $600.0K, but this appears to refer to the overall consultant contract rather than an sbp fee.
references_qualifications: Requested disciplines: civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, planning/master planning, stormwater, traffic design engineering, and transportation planning. No specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the notice.
